newsitem.title: USA: U.S. light vehicle sales rise 1.4 pct in March.
newsitem.headline: U.S. light vehicle sales rise 1.4 pct in March.

text.p: U.S. car and light truck sales during the month of March totaled 1,396,392 units with all automakers reporting, a 1.4 percent increase from the 1,376,518 units sold a year earlier.

The seasonally adjusted annual sales rate for the month was 15.83 million units, up from 15.46 million units a year earlier, and 15.3 million units for the month of February. The rate is calculated with seasonal factors supplied by the U.S. Commerce Department.
Automakers sold 627,346 North American-built cars in the United States in March, down 5.6 percent from a year ago.
The seasonally adjusted annual rate for domestic cars was 7.09 million units, compared with 7.45 million in March 1996 and 6.9 million in February.

Automakers sold 576,500 domestic trucks in the U.S. during March, up 5.6 percent from a year earlier. The seasonally adjusted annual sales rate for domestic trucks was 6.57 million units, compared with 6.14 million a year earlier and 6.31 million in February.

Imported car sales totaled 138,815 units, up 8.5 percent from a year ago, with a seasonally adjusted annual rate of 1.54 million units. Imported truck sales jumped 41.8 percent to 53,731 units for an annual rate of 62,000 units.
